notes: OKA (oka.com/uk). Site has NO page/collection anywhere named Clearance, Outlet, Final Sale, Last Chance, or End of Line - checked full /collections.json (336 handles, 2 pages) for those exact terms and local synonyms; none found. The only markdown-merchandising concept on the site is 'Sale', reached via a full nav mega-menu ('Explore Sale' -> 'Shop All Sale' /collections/sale, title 'Sale', id 623297003787) with 8 genuine children: Sale Furniture, Sale Homeware, Sale Lighting, Sale Garden, Sale Textiles (all 5 also in the top nav dropdown itself), plus Sale Bedroom, Sale Dining Room, Sale Living Room (surfaced via a clc-Banner_Collections quick-link block on the /collections/sale hub page, same real-PLP pattern as the Bestsellers/New Arrivals sub-listings). A 9th collection, 'sale-cushions' (Sale Cushions, id 631059611915), exists in /collections.json but is NOT linked from the top nav, NOT linked from the /collections/sale hub's banner, and not reachable from any other checked page - it appears to be an orphaned/superseded collection (its content is already covered by 'Sale Textiles': 'From scatter cushions to throws and floor coverings...'), so it was excluded as not a genuine site-exposed sub-listing. SALE VS CLEARANCE JUDGMENT (per brief Rule 2): every Sale collection here is Shopify-rule-driven purely off 'is_price_reduced is_set' (a live, ever-changing discount flag, not a tag like 'clearance' or 'outlet'), and none of the on-page copy uses clearance/outlet/final/end-of-line language - Sale Homeware's body text is generic promotional copy ('now available at special sale prices... exceptional value'). However, it is not a dated/seasonal campaign either (no 'Black Friday', 'Summer Sale', percent-off countdown, etc.) - it is a permanent, evergreen top-level nav item, and the hub page's own copy warns 'If you spot something to treasure, don't hesitate - blink and it could be gone forever', which signals non-restocked, once-gone-permanently stock, a clearance-like trait. This is genuinely ambiguous under the brief's own test, so every row below is recorded (not silently excluded) with an AMBIGUOUS SALE/CLEARANCE flag rather than a guess either way. Also note: the parent Sale hub (46 products) is much SMALLER than several individual children (e.g. Sale Homeware alone is 398) - the site's own product_count values, recorded as-is; the hub is evidently a differently-curated feed, not the union of all 8 children, verified by exhaustion for the hub itself (its returned page-1 HTML contained exactly 46 [data-graphene-hc-el="item"] tiles = its full product_count, single page).

On-page copy: 'Enjoy substantial savings on furniture, homeware and lighting. If you spot something to treasure, don't hesitate - blink and it could be gone forever.' Shopify rule: is_price_reduced is_set (dynamic markdown flag, no clearance/outlet tag).
